title: A077754 — Murthy's conjecture: prescribed digit sums in residue classes (Lean 4)
description: Machine-checked proof of theorem A077754: for every n, there exists a multiple N of n with all-nonzero digits, digit sum n and at least 2 digits, iff n is not in {1,2,5,11} and not divisible by 10. Unconditional, proved for all n. Trust base: the Lean kernel alone — #print axioms A077754 = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; every finite certificate is kernel-checked by decide (bitmap certificates in A077754Cert.lean); no native_decide, no sorryAx.
